page.content:
Shari — short-grain rice seasoned with vinegar, sugar, and salt.

How Sushi rice connects

  • Topic: Sushi — Seasoned sushi rice is what makes a piece sushi.
  • Item: Rice vinegar — Rice vinegar, with salt and sugar, turns cooked rice into shari.

What is Sushi rice?

Sushi rice (shari) is the craft that itamae name before the fish: cooked, fanned, and dressed so each nigiri holds and tastes seasoned, not plain.

Key threads lead to Sushi and Rice vinegar.
